messages:
sylvia: Canary for payments-service chart v2.3.0 is stuck in the canary stage — deploy-bot shows a chart verification error after the chart registry rotated signing keys. anyone on-call?

deploy-bot: Canary deploy failed for payments-service-canary (release payments-canary): helm upgrade --install returned non-zero exit code.
Error: chart verification failed: cosign: verification error: no matching public key found for signature
Logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/deploys/3178901234
Reaction: :warning:

jordan: ugh. did v2.3.0 include any DB migrations or breaking values? we should avoid pinning if migrations are required.

alex: quick check — v2.3.0 changelog shows only tracing flag + chart metadata; no db migrations. safe to pin back to v2.2.7 for the canary.

kazu: confirmed — I looked at the chart contents and there are no migrations. the only change is new `tracing.enabled` default and a minor config tweak. pinning should be safe for a short window.

sylvia: ok — proposal: annotate the release so deploy-bot won't try v2.3.0 for the canary, then re-run canary using v2.2.7. we should keep v2.3.0 blocked until sig key rotation is resolved. also note in release notes and mark the change window. :white_check_mark:

alex: applying annotation now — will also post the helm rollback command.

alex: command I ran:
```bash
kubectl annotate release payments-canary redwood.inference/release-pin=v2.2.7 --namespace=infra --overwrite
helm upgrade payments-canary redwood-charts/payments --version 2.2.7 --namespace infra --reuse-values --wait
```
helm output: "Release \"payments-canary\" has been upgraded. Status: deployed"

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook link: https://runbooks/internal/release-pin
Notes: pinned releases count toward manual-change-window. If canary succeeds, schedule a follow-up to unpin once cosign key rotation confirmed.

sylvia: thanks alex. i'll watch metrics for the next 30m. alex / jordan please add a one-line note to the release notes: "Canary temporarily pinned to v2.2.7 due to chart signature rotation — v2.3.0 blocked pending key rotation (see infra-317890 for follow-up)."

jordan: added the note to the release draft and created infra ticket infra-317890 to rotate cosign keys and publish new public key. i'll cc security.

sylvia: perfect. if canary shows any regressions we'll rollback fully, otherwise we'll unpin after key rotation and re-trigger canary. thanks all :rocket:
